name: animation-society
description: Animation Society bilingual website and membership MVP (MERN modular monolith)

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @as/api" "npm run dev -w @as/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @as/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @as/web
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @as/api && npm run build -w @as/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:contracts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:contracts && MONGODB_URI_TEST=${MONGODB_URI_TEST:-mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/animation_society_it?replicaSet=rs0&directConnection=true} npm run test:integration -w @as/api
